login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Your private teaching workspace
login.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.
changePassword.forcedSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own before you continue.
changePassword.policy: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist or has moved.

settings.languageHint: Used on every device you sign in on.
settings.passwordHint: Change the password you use to sign in.

today.title: Today
today.sessionsEmpty: Lessons you schedule for today will appear here, ready to join and wrap up.
today.reviewEmpty: Homework your students hand in will wait here for grading, oldest first.

home.tasksEmpty: Tasks from your tutor will appear here, the soonest due first.
home.nextSessionEmpty: Your next lesson will appear here once it is scheduled.

students.title: Students
students.empty: Each student you add gets their own sign-in and a private workspace.
students.archivedEmpty: Students you archive appear here. They cannot sign in until you restore them.
students.userNameHint: Suggested from the name. 3–40 characters: a–z, 0–9, dot, dash, underscore.
students.temporaryPasswordHint: The student changes it at first sign-in. Leave it empty to have one generated.
students.failed: Could not copy. Select the text instead.

created.title: Account created
created.text: Send these sign-in details to {{name}}. The password is shown only now.

overview.nextSessionEmpty: The next session with this student appears here once it is scheduled.
overview.tasksEmpty: Activities you assign to this student appear here, soonest due first.
overview.goalsEmpty: Goals and their progress appear here once you set them.

notFound.title: Student not found
notFound.body: This student does not exist or was deleted.

account.title: Account
account.resetText: Gives the student a new temporary password. They choose their own at the next sign-in.
account.resetConfirmText: The current password stops working and the student is signed out everywhere. The new temporary password is shown once.
account.issued: New temporary password. It is shown only now: send it to the student.
account.unlockText: Too many wrong passwords locked this account. Unlock it so the student can try again now.
account.archiveText: Hides the student from the active list and stops them signing in. Nothing is deleted.
account.archiveConfirmText: An archived student cannot sign in and is signed out now. Their profile and work are kept, and you can restore them at any time.
account.restoreText: This student is archived and cannot sign in. Restoring lets them sign in again with their current password.
account.restoreConfirmText: The student can sign in again and appears in the active list. Their data is unchanged.
account.deleteText: Removes the account and all of the student’s records. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmText: The account, profile and every record of this student are removed for good. To keep the data, archive the student instead.
